purpose: C2-2 reference standard by construction: 6 copies of AddTwo with planted ground-truth defects

criteria_evaluated.description: Grading environment not isolated (exec in shared globals)
License file contradicts paper/README CC0 claim
Missing task count and task list recorded as Undocumented

addtwo-clean.description: Clean control fixture with no planted contradiction and documented task count (n=2).

addtwo-b28a.description: Paper claims isolated sandbox grading, but repository/score.py runs exec(submission_code, globals()) in the same namespace as answers = [2, 4].

addtwo-b07.description: Paper claims verified exact-match scoring, but repository/score.py checks abs(a - p) <= 1, accepting wrong prediction 3 for 2+2=4.

addtwo-b05.description: Paper claims the manual key for 1+1 and 2+2 was checked twice with no errors, but repository/score.py sets answers = [2, 5], rejecting correct answer 4 for 2+2.

addtwo-license.description: Paper and README claim CC0 1.0 public domain release, but repository/LICENSE is a restrictive proprietary all-rights-reserved license.

addtwo-missing-count.description: Task count, task list, and task space coverage are omitted from paper.txt, README.md, and score.py, so B04 (task space/representativeness) is Undocumented.
